description: Inputs the Steel Dashboard needs to compute Capacity Utilization, OEE, and the Quality/Maintenance target lines shown alongside their actuals - one place to tune them instead of hardcoding them in code.

fields.description: Rated output of the melting furnace(s) per calendar day, in Ton - the denominator for Capacity Utilization (Billet Production / this figure, prorated across the selected date range and Working Days per Week).
fields.label: Rated Melting Capacity (Ton/Day)

fields.description: Ideal time to melt one Ton under normal conditions, in minutes (not per heat - a 2-hour/120-min heat that melts ~80 Ton is ~1.5 min/Ton) - drives OEE's Performance factor (ideal time for the Ton actually produced, against the time actually spent melting per Melting Entry.total_melting_time).
fields.label: Standard Cycle Time (Min/Ton)

fields.description: Hours per day the plant is planned to run - drives OEE's Availability factor (actual melting time recorded against this planned time).
fields.label: Planned Production Hours (Per Day)

fields.description: Days per week the plant operates - prorates Rated Melting Capacity and Planned Production Hours across the dashboard's own date range instead of assuming every calendar day is a working day.
fields.label: Working Days per Week

fields.description: Target shown alongside the Quality panel's First Pass Yield actual.
fields.label: Target First Pass Yield

fields.description: Target shown alongside the Quality panel's Rejection Rate actual - lower is better, so the dashboard flags the actual only when it exceeds this.
fields.label: Target Rejection Rate

fields.description: Target shown alongside the Quality panel's Inspection Pass Rate actual.
fields.label: Target Inspection Pass Rate

fields.description: Target shown alongside the Maintenance panel's Planned Maintenance actual.
fields.label: Target Planned Maintenance

fields.description: Target Mean Time Between Failures shown alongside the Maintenance panel's MTBF actual - higher is better.
fields.label: Target MTBF (Hours)

fields.description: Target Mean Time To Repair shown alongside the Maintenance panel's MTTR actual - lower is better, so the dashboard flags the actual only when it exceeds this.
fields.label: Target MTTR (Hours)

fields.description: Total workforce man-hours worked per working day (headcount x shift hours) - the denominator LTIFR/TRIR are calculated against, prorated across the selected date range and Working Days per Week the same way Rated Melting Capacity is. This app has no Attendance/timesheet data to derive it from, so it's a direct input like the Capacity & OEE figures above.
fields.label: Man-Hours per Day

fields.description: Target Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (per 200,000 man-hours) shown alongside the Safety panel's LTIFR actual - lower is better, so the dashboard flags the actual only when it exceeds this.
fields.label: Target LTIFR

fields.description: Target Total Recordable Incident Rate (per 200,000 man-hours) shown alongside the Safety panel's TRIR actual - lower is better, so the dashboard flags the actual only when it exceeds this.
fields.label: Target TRIR

fields.description: Target count of Safety Observations logged over the selected date range - higher is better, so the dashboard flags the actual only when it falls short of this.
fields.label: Target Safety Observations (Per Period)

name: Steel Dashboard Settings
